$comment: The catalog's source of truth (spec #17 §2). Ingestion reads this and never invents metadata. Each entry's sourceUrl and license are verified by hand against the source; a cover, when present, requires coverLicense and coverSource because Gutenberg's text is public domain but its scanned cover art often is not. Add a book: add an entry, run `npm run ingest -- --slug <slug> --target local --dry-run`, read the committed report, then ingest and publish.
$coverComment: Covers (spec #19 §2) are supplied, never generated or transformed by ingestion. Each one was located on Wikimedia Commons, its licence read from that file's own description page, and the file fetched at a Commons-rendered width that already satisfies the 2:3 tolerance, the byte limit and the minimum width — no local cropping and no re-encoding. A book whose art could not be verified as freely licensed, or whose only available rendition failed validation, simply has no `cover` entry and renders GeneratedCover. A mixed shelf is the intended end state, not a gap.
